LAREDO, Texas — Martin Valadez Jr. was arrested Tuesday afternoon, October 21, 2026, and booked into the Webb County Jail on an alleged second-degree felony charge of possession of a controlled substance in penalty group 2 in an amount of 4 grams or more but less than 400 grams, according to Webb County booking records.

Valadez was arrested at 5:23 p.m. by the Webb County Sheriff's Office. The booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956 listed one charge.

Bond had not been set as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. The booking record listed one charge; no court case number was listed.

A second-degree felony in Texas is punishable by two to 20 years in prison and a fine of up to $10,000.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Martin Valadez Jr. is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
